findings.claim: Protected files can be edited by spelling an in-repo target with a leading `..` relative path, because the guard allows any relative path that `rel()` returns as outside the project.
findings.evidence: The guard calls `rel(projectDir(), target)` directly and allows `relative === null`; `rel()` returns null for relative paths whose normalized segments climb above the starting point (`normalizeSegmentsOrNull` comment: `Returns null when a relative path climbs above its starting point`). Thus a tool path like `../<repo-name>/internal/basedef/profiles-types.min.json.gz` can resolve to the protected file but be allowed, violating acceptance criterion 1.1's requirement that the PreToolUse hook deny protected paths.
findings.suggested_fix: Resolve relative tool paths against `projectDir()` before computing the project-relative path, e.g. normalize/join `projectDir()` and `target` first, then call `rel(root, resolvedTarget)`.

findings.claim: The new settings register hook scripts that are not added by this change, so those hook events will invoke missing files.
findings.evidence: The new `.claude/settings.json` references `${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/dist/agent-ledger.mjs` and `${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/dist/karpathy-flush.mjs`, but the diff only adds `gofmt-check.mjs`, `guard-generated.mjs`, `license-header.mjs`, `session-context.mjs`, and their libs/tests; no `agent-ledger.mjs` or `karpathy-flush.mjs` is added.
findings.suggested_fix: Either include the referenced dist scripts in the change or remove these extra hook registrations from the new settings file.
